Description
Issued from the island nation of Samoa comes the fourth release of this low mintage bullion coin featuring a seahorse among coral. The low mintages make these coins a unique treasure to own. Add them to your collection today!
Design of 1 oz Silver Coin – 2 Tala Samoa Silver Seahorse BU
This is the fourth annual release of the Samoan Seahorse, issued by the Samoan government in partnership with the Scottsdale Mint. The seahorse, named as such for its horse-like head, is native to the tropical waters surrounding the Samoan Islands in the South Pacific Ocean and can most often be found feeding or hiding in the ocean’s mangrove forests and sea grass beds.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Silver Coin – Samoa Silver Seahorse BU
Contains 1 oz of .999 fine Silver.
Each coin comes in a protective plastic capsule.
Low mintage of 15,000 coins.
Obverse: Features the Samoan crest along with denomination of 2 Tala.
Reverse: Features a seahorse among coral surrounded by a patterned border.
This
coin is manufactured and distributed by Scottsdale Mint and is legal tender in Samoa.
